verdicts.reason: A: the lime panel takes up almost the whole canvas, so the striped background that defines the brand shrinks to a thin border. The '48H ONLY' badge is shrunk to an unreadable pink dot jammed into the top-right corner. Headline, subcopy and box float with large dead gaps between them and the CTA, and the subcopy sits too tight under the headline. B: keeps the original structure (box on stripes, then a lime band with headline, copy and CTA), so it reads as the same design. But the '48H ONLY' badge text is too small to read, the subcopy wraps with an orphaned 'stock.', and the box crowds the right edge.
